summary: P1 refactor verification: server.py split into 9 router modules + 6 model modules + utils/legacy_units.py. Zero business logic changes. All 67 tests PASSED (100%). Covered: (a) 22 smoke GETs across all extracted routers, (b) 7 endpoints ObjectId-leak checks, (c) full CRUD cycles for buffet-factors / suppliers / recipes / plated-menus / inventory (ingredients) / events, (d) endpoints using re-imported helpers: _resolve_buffet_factor (buffet-factors, kitchen-beo/batch, plated-menus/projected-cost), calculate_recipe_cost (recipes/cost-history, /scale), _recalc_recipes_using_ingredient (inventory extended update). (e) Regression check confirmed FIXED: POST /api/recipes/{id}/duplicate no longer leaks MongoDB _id/ObjectId (assert '_id' not in body passes). Kitchen-BEO batch works. Backend supervisor logs show clean startup, no import errors, no tracebacks.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is still 15,542 lines — consider further extraction of remaining modules (calendar, financials, tasks, documents, exports) in a follow-up sprint P2.
routers/inventory.py is 1,999 lines and contains an interleaved purchase_list_router — split purchase_lists into its own router file for consistency.
routers/proposals.py is 2,117 lines (largest new router) — consider splitting proposal-items and proposal-templates into sub-routers for maintainability.
culinary_digest.py has a pre-existing broken import (list_cost_variance) currently silenced with try/except — NOT caused by this refactor but should be resolved to avoid hiding future regressions.
All extracted routers correctly strip MongoDB _id from responses — no ObjectId serialization leaks detected across 7 sampled list endpoints and all created-doc responses.
seed_data_creation: All test data prefixed with P1TEST_<uuid> and cleaned up via CRUD delete steps in each test class. No stray data left in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: P1 structural refactor of server.py verified as non-regressing. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_p1_refactor_verification.py provides 67 tests covering all extracted routers with full CRUD + ObjectId-leak checks. Re-run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_p1_refactor_verification.py -v` after any further server.py splits (P2). Known non-issue: pre-existing culinary_digest.list_cost_variance import handled with try/except at import time.
rca of the issue: N/A - No bugs found. Both bugs the main agent fixed during refactor are verified: (1) POST /api/recipes/{id}/duplicate correctly pops _id before returning (test_duplicate_no_objectid_leak passes); (2) Legacy shadowed /api/events/purchase-orders* routes removed cleanly - GET /api/purchase-orders returns 200 via the new purchase_orders router without conflicts.
